description: This file defines the CloneValue class, a method operation for the MiniLang framework in Apache OFBiz, implementing the <clone-value> element to clone a GenericValue from one field to another within a method context.

classes.name: CloneValue
classes.description: A method operation class that clones a GenericValue from one field to another within the method context.

classes.name: CloneValueFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CloneValue.

methods.name: CloneValue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the clone operation based on XML element attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the clone operation, copying a GenericValue from the source field to the target field in the environment map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the clone-value element.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a CloneValue instance from XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation, 'clone-value'.
